THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 5

I, John Anthony Emmanuel Amarathunga, Minister of Lands, herebydeclare under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of the Land AcquisitionAct, that the land described below is needed for a public purpose andwill be acquired under the provisions of that Act.

The allotment of below mentioned land (Lot 01) total extent of about0.0519 Hectare, depicted in Advance Tracing No. H/HMB/RDA/2015/149 & dated 28.10.2015, prepared by the Senior Superintandent ofSurvey on behalf of the surveyor - General, situated in the Villages ofGonnoruwa, Seenukkugala and Minor Division of Magam Paththuwain the Divisional Secretary's Division of Hambanthota in HambanthotaDistrict in Southern Province and bounded as follows:
01. Lot ‘ET’ – Extent: 0.0519 HectareNorth: Part of the Road (R.D.A) and Lot EG; East: Lot ES; South:Lots ES and EU;West: Part of the Road (R.D.A).
John A. E. Amarathunga,Minister of Lands
Ref. No.: 4-3/6/2014/HW/402.24th May 2016Ministry of Lands,“Mihikatha Medura”,Rajamalwaththa Road,Battaramulla.
